newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle top at $120/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle top at $120/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not well tested on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Few lots Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1300 lbs 120.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - Few lots Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1200 lbs 119.50-120.00.

Slaughter steers and heifers were not established. Demand and seller interest very uneven. Many showlists already traded. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales. Confirmed - 2,000 For the week - 56,000
